subject: Shiny.io Install packages error on Windows

messages.author: a60d28d0ae3bdda8
messages.subject: Shiny.io Install packages error on Windows
parts:
Hi,

I've tried to deploy my Shiny app to the shiny.io server, but it ends up greyed out as soon as it's deployed. I checked the shiny logs, and it shows an error:

"ERROR: there is no package called 'gplots'"

The first line of my server file is "library(gplots)". I have also tried "require(gplots)" but I still get the same error.

I'm running Windows 7, and the gplots package is installed locally under my own user folder -- so when I try to run the app locally I have no problems, but I can't deploy it successfully.

I've tried looking up help on this error but all the examples I could find were for Linux users.

Please tell me what I can do to get shiny.io to install the package correctly.

Thanks,

Louise
